claim: Creates a printable guide, role cards, instruction cards, and challenge cards.
sandbox: Fresh browser context; open the landing page, choose Try it with sample data, and count the populated sample output.
Fresh demo; select each time and verify the printed guide and number of challenge cards.

claim: Provides a printed-card activity without student devices or an account.
where: landing headline and product description, README
sandbox: Fresh demo; change the activity and verify a print-ready guide and cards are available without a credential step.

claim: The sample kit is free to use without payment or sign-in.
sandbox: Fresh browser context; open and change the sample kit, then verify the populated output and print action without an account flow.

claim: Print or save the kit as a PDF from the browser.
sandbox: Fresh demo; apply the shipped print CSS and create an A4 Chromium PDF, then verify it has populated PDF pages.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: A new browser context opens /demo online until controlled by the service worker, sets offline mode, reloads /demo, and verifies the sample output.

claim: Sample changes stay separate from your saved kit.
where: landing facts, builder introduction, privacy page, README
sandbox: Fresh browser context; save a normal team count, change the demo count, choose Start for real, and verify the normal count returns.

claim: The app does not send kit settings to another service or load tracking scripts.
sandbox: Fresh demo browser context records every request while settings change and requires same-origin GET requests only.
